flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Company Summary ProFound™ Therapeutics is a biotechnology company discovering novel proteins across the expanded human proteome to unlock transformative drug targets and first-in-class medicines. The company’s proprietary ProFoundry™ Platform integrates state-of-the-art protein detection, validation, and computational technologies to systematically identify and characterize previously unknown proteins and validate their therapeutic potential. This approach has generated a rapidly expanding portfolio of novel targets and programs advancing toward the clinic, along with strategic collaborations with leading pharmaceutical partners. Together, these efforts support the development of breakthrough treatments across a broad range of disease areas. For more information, please visit www.profoundtx.com . Position Summary ProFound Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Director, Alliance & Program Management to serve as an operational and strategic partner to the Chief Operating Officer, leadership team, and program teams. This role has two primary responsibilities: (1) serving as the day-to-day operational leader for ProFound's strategic pharmaceutical collaborations and (2) building the company's portfolio and program management capabilities. The role ensures successful alliance and program execution while developing the governance, planning processes, and operating systems that enable disciplined execution across the company's growing portfolio. This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional judgment, operational rigor, and the ability to influence without authority. The ideal candidate is an experienced biotechnology operator who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution. They thrive in a lean, entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve rapidly and success depends on bringing structure to complexity, building practical solutions, fostering collaboration, and driving accountability across highly matrixed teams. Key Responsibilities Alliance Management Serve as the primary Alliance Manager and operational leader for ProFound's strategic pharmaceutical collaborations, ensuring successful execution of scientific objectives, governance activities, and contractual commitments. Build trusted relationships across partner organizations while coordinating cross-functional scientific, legal, finance, IP, and operational teams to drive alliance execution. Lead Joint Steering Committees (JSCs) and other governance forums, ensuring meetings are well prepared, decisions documented, and actions successfully executed. Partner with Business Development to help structure new alliances for successful execution. Translate collaboration agreements into executable operating plans, proactively managing milestones, deliverables, risks, issues, and partner expectations. Monitor alliance health and performance, resolving conflicts constructively and providing executive leadership with clear visibility into key risks and opportunities. Build credibility through exceptional execution, proactive communication, sound judgment, and effective stakeholder management. Program Management Build and continuously improve ProFound's portfolio and program management capabilities, including governance, tools, and operating processes. Lead integrated program management across discovery and early development programs, ensuring visibility into progress, risks, and resource needs. Train and support scientific teams in adopting practical project management tools and consistent execution practices. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f47ada51-54e6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Creative Strategist (DTC E-Commerce) based in India. This is a performance-focused creative strategy role within a fast-growing direct-to-consumer e-commerce environment. You will own the creative system behind paid advertising, from customer research and ideation through production and performance analysis. Your work will directly influence acquisition, conversion, and profitable growth across paid channels. You’ll develop high-performing concepts, hooks, scripts, copy, and creative briefs while collaborating with designers, editors, and content creators. Own landing-page messaging and strategy for paid campaigns, collaborating with relevant teams to improve conversion and customer journeys. Analyse advertising performance to identify winning patterns, creative fatigue, and new opportunities, using insights to guide future testing. Develop variations of successful creative concepts across hooks, copy, CTAs, visuals, and formats to accelerate testing and scale performance. Maintain a structured creative roadmap, testing cadence, launch schedule, production workflow, approvals process, and quality standards. Build and maintain libraries of proven hooks, frameworks, winning structures, playbooks, and creative learnings. Collaborate closely with performance marketing, design, video, and UGC teams to maintain a consistent flow of high-quality creative. Present regular creative performance updates and actionable recommendations for future tests and improvements. Requirements 3+ years of experience in direct-response creative strategy for DTC e-commerce, whether in-house, agency, or freelance. Demonstrated experience writing or developing ad scripts, VSL scripts, and static ad copy that generated measurable commercial results. Strong understanding of direct-response copywriting principles and frameworks such as AIDA and PAS. Deep knowledge of Meta Ads and experience working in high-volume creative testing environments. Proven ability to create detailed creative briefs and manage creative production workflows from concept through delivery. Strong understanding of consumer psychology, buyer motivations, and the factors that drive engagement and conversion. Ability to analyse performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction. Experience using AI-powered tools such as Claude or Gemini to support research, ideation, and content development. Excellent written English with the ability to communicate ideas clearly, persuasively, and concisely. Highly analytical, commercially minded, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable making decisions based on evidence and testing. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or beauty DTC brands is a plus. Experience with TikTok or YouTube advertising, UGC creator management, landing-page copywriting, or CRO is advantageous. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:d74b426e-3da.title: 長期Internshipに直結！【9月9日(水)・9月10日(木)】Pairs 2 Days Internship Workshop
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:d74b426e-3da.description: エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。 Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,500万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。(2025年現在)2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、100万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。 2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。 開催日時： 9月9日 (水)・9月10日 (木) 9:00 開始予定 イベント概要： 国内最大級の恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営するエウレカでは、Pairs 2 Days Internship Workshopを開催します。 本インターンワークショップでは、Pairsのプロダクトやマーケティングがどのように企画・実行されているかを実例を交えてレクチャーするほか、学生同士で取り組む実践型の企画ワークショップも実施。テーマは「Pairsの新しい体験を企画し、その価値を消費者にどう届けるか」。チームごとにユーザー理解・課題設定から、機能や体験の企画、GTM戦略・メッセージング設計、プレゼンまでを行っていただきます。 当日は、実際にプロダクト開発・マーケティングを担当しているメンバーがメンターとして伴走。最終プレゼンでは、経営陣を含む審査メンバーからフィードバックを行い、優秀なチームには表彰も予定しています。 将来的に、プロダクトマネージャーやマーケティング、事業企画などの領域で活躍したい方にとって、リアルな現場と実践型アウトプットを通じて、ユーザー理解・課題解決力・企画力を磨ける2日間です。 Pairsの成長の裏側に触れ、自らの可能性を広げたい方のご応募をお待ちしています。 イベント詳細はこちらをご覧ください。 プログラム内容： ペアーズのプロダクト開発・マーケティング戦略事例のレクチャー 学生チームによる「Pairsの新しい体験と届け方」をテーマにした企画立案ワーク 現場メンターによるフィードバック・伴走支援 最終プレゼン/審査＆表彰（経営陣を含む審査メンバーが担当） 本インターンワークショップの魅力： マッチングアプリビジネスや、Pairsのプロダクト・マーケティングに対する理解を深める 現役で活躍している社員がメンターとして企画立案をサポートするので、ビジネス企画に関する実践的な知識を身につけることができる 参加者の一部の方には長期インターンシップの選考に直結したご案内 企画立案ワークショップで優勝されたグループを最優秀賞として表彰
